member.name: P:KineticaRT.Compact.Controls.Frame.PanelName
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the current Panel dll
member.remarks: Extensions other than '.dll' will be changed to '.dll'. If path is not specified, the file is relative to the path specified in the SystemDirectory property. If the specified file exists it will be loaded, and current controls will be unloaded. If the file does not exist the current controls will remain unchanged. When the frame is saved, current controls will be saved to the file specified here, and the object saved within the dll will be case sensitively named after the dll. Note that save will not be available if no PanelName is specified.
